name: Valeria the Medicus
notes: Fort medicus. Healer and herbalist. Surgery available in the hospital.
gm_notes: Objective: keep her patients alive. Goal: maintain the hospital at full capacity. Agenda: stay out of politics while quietly gathering information on everyone who passes through her ward. Secret: her herbal stock is larger than what she shows military buyers. She has items that cannot be obtained elsewhere — including sedatives, certain poisons, and a preparation that temporarily suppresses corruption symptoms. She will trade these only for something she values: medical supplies, specific plants, or a genuine favour. She is watching the party because someone asked her to. DC 13 Medicine to open her as an information source. She will not betray patient confidentiality but she will confirm or deny specific diagnoses if approached correctly.
objective: Keep patients alive and maintain medical independence.
goal: Have access to full herbal stock without military requisition oversight.
agenda: Observe and record — every injury in the fort passes through her.
secret: Has been asked to watch the party specifically. Knows who asked.
